method: Three bounded ordinary Playwright UI answers, followed by passive REA observation.
findings: The original screen displayed 12 words and an initial 20-question counter.
The completed-word counter stayed at zero after three submitted questions; answering once and completing a word are distinct concepts.
limitations: Only three steps observed; the exact source mastery threshold and scheduling algorithm remain unknown.
Source account progress was not imported into the local app.
The local required_correct=2 retrieval option is an explicit independent implementation choice, not a recovered source algorithm.
